Jordan —

Quick read for the items Maya listed:
- Additional insured: acceptable on Commercial General Liability with a primary/non-contributory endorsement. We'll commit to naming Acme Enterprises and its affiliates on our CGL COI.
- Waiver of subrogation: we can accept waiver for our policies where permitted by carrier — need to confirm on Cyber (some carriers restrict).
- Limits: E&O/Professional Liability at $5M and Cyber at $5M are higher than our standard program. Our program carries $3M E&O and $3M Cyber; we can offer a $5M endorsement with an excess policy but that requires prior approval from carrier and may add cost.
- Cancellation notice: carriers provide 30 days' notice for cancellation in most cases; we'll include that.

Recommendation: offer a signed COI naming Acme as additional insured on the CGL, include waiver of subrogation where allowed, and propose a commercial redline to the Order Form/MA S that documents the limits understanding and provides a path to secure $5M limits within 30 days post-signature (if Acme insists on $5M before signature). If Acme will not accept a post-signature remediation, we should propose a limited premium pass-through or credit in the order form.

Markus — can you prepare a short redline and a COI stub we can send?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
